text:
sam: Did anyone catch last night's MNF? Benching D. Harris was brutal. :sob:
jules: Yup, that fumble killed me. Thinking of grabbing Kenneth Walker off waivers before playoffs.
marina: Walker's snagged in 3 leagues already. If you're in standard, his upside is big next two weeks.
trevor: waiver priority = 8 for me. Anyone willing to trade a low RB for him? I'll throw in my flex WR for depth.
sam: Offer a 4th? I'm desperate. My RBs are Zeke (bye), D. Harris (meh), and a handcuff.
jules: I'm willing to trade Emmanuel Sanders (lol) + pick swap for Walker. :shrug: 
marina: Quick poll: should waivers be FAAB or priority for our mini-playoff (weeks 14-16)? React with :moneybag: for FAAB, :dart: for priority.
ops-bot: Poll created: FAAB vs Priority. Voting open 12 hours.
trevor: FAAB ftw. Keeps it fair when you tank early.
sam: priority feels rigged towards teams that didn't improve. I'm pro-FAAB.
jules: FAAB. Also if someone grabs Walker and wins the whole thing I'm blaming the waiver rules.
marina: Also FYI, Robinson is questionable wk15. Might shuffle things.
ops-bot: Current votes: FAAB 3, Priority 1. Time left: 11:34:22.
sam: If FAAB wins, who has credits to bid? I'll probably go 60-70% of my bank.
trevor: I have 120. Willing to splurge if Walker starts.
jules: 30 credits. low but might nuke it for playoffs.
marina: I'll reserve 100 for a late-season buy.
ops-bot: Poll closed: FAAB wins 4-1. League settings updated to FAAB for playoffs.
sam: Thanks ops-bot. Guess I'll draft a bid plan. Good luck y'all. :crossed_fingers:
